posts.text: 😲In the past week #SPUT has used its large cash position to add another 250,000 lbs #U3O8 to its #Uranium stack.🛢️☢️🛒🤨 Why has it chosen to draw down its cash holdings while sentiment has been rock bottom with its shares trading at a deep discount to NAV?🥴 Lots of possibilities: 🤔Sprott may have lined up a private placement with an institutional investor getting ready to drop a large wad of cash into #SPUT 💰 🤔SPUT's buyer Per Jander may not see many lbs available at this price level so he's grabbing what's on offer before the price rises.🛍️ He may also be seeing a growing number of buyers lining up to compete for the lbs on offer - utilities, hedge funds, hoarders and other financial players.😨 🤔Sprott wants to attract more investors and pull up sentiment😍 by using its cash to push up the Spot price in order to grow #SPUT as well as ETFs $URNM and $URNJ so as to increase its collected AUM-related fees and commissions... ie. profits!🪙 🤔Sprott has been seeing the same signs that U and I have been seeing🪧👀 that suggest that both sentiment and U sector stocks have found a mid-summer rock bottom🪨🪸 so it's trying to get ahead of the curve and firmly establish a sector bottom as we head into a period of strong seasonal upside for the U sector.🏇 Those are a few ideas.💡 U probably have a few of your own!🤠🐂 Get positioned to ride the wave!🌊🏄
